title: Restriction modules with their category recorded
statement: For a commutative condensed ring object Λ, scheme maps f:Y→X and g:Z→Y and an internal p_X^*Λ-module N [def-sfb-integral-models-stacks-data], pointModelRestriction Λ f N g is the existing inverse-image module (g≫f)^*N, in the category of internal p_Z^*Λ-modules. It is evaluation of the actual inverse-image functor, with no witness choice.

source.place: Tag 03CY (finite presentations) and Sites Tag 00YV (functoriality of modules); named existing constructions for the discrete local-model comparison.

def pointModelRestriction
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) :
    Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z)
